name: Levofloxacin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 500 mg every 24 hours for 7 to 14 days, or 750 mg every 24 hours for 5 days
750 mg every 24 hours for 7 to 14 days

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Multivalent cations: Mg/Al antacids, sucralfate, iron, zinc multivitamins, didanosine
key_interactions.action: Give these at least 2 hours before or 2 hours after levofloxacin.
Monitor PT/INR closely and watch for bleeding.

key_interactions.effect: Additive QT prolongation, torsades de pointes.

common: Nausea, headache, diarrhea, insomnia, constipation, dizziness (≥3%)
serious: Central nervous system and psychiatric effects (boxed warning)

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to levofloxacin or other quinolones
monitoring: Tendon pain, neuropathy and mental status changes

pk.half_life_eskd: About 76 ± 42 hours on hemodialysis; 51 ± 24 hours on CAPD; 35 hours at CrCl <20 mL/min (label)
pk.metabolism: Limited (desmethyl and N-oxide metabolites, under 5% of dose)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 87% unchanged in urine within 48 hours
pk.dialyzability: No: not efficiently removed by hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis (label).
